objective: Give a practical framework for comparing more than one loan offer.

slides.headline: What does it mean?

caption:
When more than one offer is on the table, comparing them properly means using the same criteria for each — total cost, term, flexibility and security — not just glancing at whichever rate looks lowest.

A broker can prepare this comparison directly, but even a simple table you build yourself makes the differences much clearer.
